summary_en: 800,000 shares (2.96% of shares outstanding), ¥1.0B upper limit, ¥1.25M/share maximum price (¥1.0B ÷ 800,000), open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange, Aug 7, 2026 to Feb 28, 2027.
title_en: Notice of Decision of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Rheon Automatic Machinery announced on August 6, 2026 that its board of directors approved the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 165, paragraph 3 of the Companies Act. The company is authorized to acquire up to 800,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 2.96% of shares outstanding (27,003,985 shares ex-treasury as of March 31, 2026), for an aggregate amount not exceeding ¥1.0 billion. The maximum purchase price per share is ¥1,250 (¥1.0B ÷ 800,000 shares). Acquisition will be executed as open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from August 7, 2026 through February 28, 2027. The stated purpose is to implement flexible capital policy in response to changes in the operating environment and to provide returns to shareholders.
